verseText: Where there is no vision, the people perish.
missionStatement: Equipping the Church for mission and raising up faithful Christian leaders.
pastorQuote: Welcome, brothers and sisters in Christ! We are so blessed to gather and worship together. Let us keep in mind the words of Hebrews 12:28: 'Let us be grateful for receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, and thus let us offer to God acceptable worship, with reverence and awe.' No matter what you have walked through this week, you are safe and welcome in this house.
tagline: Where there is no vision, the people perish
address: Pan-Apuoth, Wanyjok Town, Aweil East County, South Sudan
